facts.title: doctor
facts.tagline: check whether this machine can run villa's First Letters workflow
facts.success: Exit code 0 with `overall: pass` or `overall: warn`. Exit code 1 with an `overall: fail` line is a finished report; exit code 1 without that line is a crash (see Failure modes).
facts.not_a_pass: `overall: pass` does not mean CUDA, PyTorch or villa's inference work; only the control run shows that. A `gpu` pass says nothing about whether the card is free or the driver matches villa's PyTorch.
facts.never: Try to sign in to Modal from a Claude cloud session because `gpu` failed (the Modal rule, hard rule 11): write a run spec instead; run hours of GPU work on a laptop CPU because the other checks passed.
